name: Omea Tools
author: Cultmetrics

sections.description:
Omea Tools bundles small, useful admin helpers into a single plugin.

Current features:

  • Toggleable feature cards in the Omea Tools admin page.
  • Duplicate posts and pages, with selectable post type support.
  • Replace attachment files from the Media Library.
  • Rename attachment files for cleaner SEO-friendly filenames.
  • Regenerate WordPress image sizes for individual images or selected Media Library batches.
  • Read-only HTTPS diagnostics with a link to WordPress Site Health.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the omea-tools folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Initial release with duplicate content and media file tools.

0.2.0

  • Added image size regeneration for individual attachments and Media Library bulk actions.
  • Added read-only HTTPS diagnostics without changing WordPress URL or SSL settings.
